results.title: Former Spain midfielder Mata retires aged 38
results.content: Mata, who made 41 international appearances, was part of the Spain squad that won the 2010 World Cup, and he helped his country win the European Championship two years later when he scored in the 4-0 final victory against Italy.

results.title: Man arrested for allegedly impersonating a prison officer in Tamale
results.content: A 19-year-old man has been arrested at Gumbihini, a suburb of Tamale, for allegedly impersonating a Ghana Prisons Service officer.

results.title: We do not fall under the Rent Act; hostel occupants are not tenants – UGEL Chief Officer
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of the University of Ghana Enterprise Limited (UGEL), Yawo Agbesi, has argued that the university's hostel facilities do not fall under the Rent Act of the Rent Control Commission of the Ministry of Works, Housing and Water Resources because students who occupy them are not tenants.

results.title: UGEL to seek court interpretation of Rent Act’s applicability to university hostels
results.content: The University of Ghana Enterprise Limited (UGEL) is preparing to take the Rent Control Commission to court to seek an interpretation of the Rent Act and establish whether university hostels fall under the law.
